steps.name: to change the future
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Iris] in the “Oracle Room.”

steps.name: memories of a girl
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Iris] in the “Oracle Room,” check someone’s memory and come back. 
2. Report the quest to [Iris] in the “Oracle Room.”

lines.text: (As the story of %s, who came back from behind Esnil, goes on, Iris's expression hardens little by little.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I see that future, I have no choice but to go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: However, Iris… . Why couldn't a spirit king like Sylphid know Glaston's information?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Someone is intentionally blocking it so that what happens inside is not exposed.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It is possible if it is a being with strong and ominous power as shown in the prophecy... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If I had been a little stronger, I would have figured it out sooner... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, that must have happened before Iris left Belos. It's definitely not Iris's fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. You keep speaking weakly… . I want to stop repeating situations... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Things like this have always happened.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: From the moment someone took a wrong belief as their belief, many lives suffered.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As a result of the Chimera Institute's work, Atlantis sank to the bottom of the sea, and Ban and Mara killed many lives to create magic stones.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Weiss tried to destroy Etoire just to save her world.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And there are even wizards who try to create new gods in a world without gods.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were witches… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, there’s something you need to know.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Not all gods are like Ceres and Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .
(Iris holds the hands of %s, who is biting his lip.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When I found out that Emperor Kaina was also looking through the gap in the great wall, I couldn't believe it... But I hoped not.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There are often people in the world who have to accept unexpected situations as fate.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: His Majesty couldn't hold out any longer and may have told his brother and %s. Ask for help... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I have to go to Glaston. So far, His Majesty's predictions have never been wrong, so I'm a little afraid of that.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I couldn't tell you, but all of the futures your Majesty has seen so far have been negative. However, little by little, things changed in a positive direction.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's not exact, but it seems like the Great Wall is stabilizing little by little thanks to %s's activities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never really believed that feeling before, but not now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will do anything to change the future I saw with Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This time it will be more dangerous than other times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll be okay because I always have Iris behind me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, %s… . Oh, wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have something to show you briefly. It's someone's memory passed down through the cracks of the great wall... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Remember?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not sure who it is, but there's one thing for sure. The place of this memory is Glaston.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was only after listening to %s's story that I could understand. When I see Glaston's information coming that I couldn't reach... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Something there is calling us to Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll see it first and then judge. Is it okay though?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please do so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I see those memories?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Close your eyes for a moment and I will remind you of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.
(Light breaks through the pale darkness that comes when you close your eyes. And the light brings back and unfolds other people's memories in unfamiliar places that you have never seen before.)
Ha, ha... .
I have to get out, I have to get out... .
(The little girl, who was struggling to run through the dried-up waterway, stops. She slightly bites her fingernails as if she is anxious.)
Wow... .
(As if the girl had made up her mind, she raised her head, looked ahead, and opened the umbrella she was holding.)
(The girl's animal-like ears shake slightly as she prepares to run forward using the umbrella as a shield.)
One, two, three!!
(The girl runs forward at the count of three, but bounces back after hitting something.)
Boom.
Ouch… . One, two, three again!!
(The girl does not stop and continues running toward the direction that appears to be the exit. But the result is the same.)
(The invisible wall blocking the girl pushes her inward harder than before.)
Boom.
I want to go out. I want to go out. Why are they not letting me go out?
If Noname is out, then I can be out too. But why are you not letting me go out? I want to go out... .
As for me, Atalanta is going out. I have to go out and meet my mom. I miss my mom!!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Mom, Mom… .
(The girl cries and continues to run outside, but she ends up back in the same place. While she is doing this, on the other side, a wizard enters the ominous space and is looking for something.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: … Ha, I came as instructed... . That can't be happening... .
(At that moment, I see Atalanta jumping out in front of me.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: … Oh, no way... .
(The wizard spots Atalanta fallen and steps back. He then carefully walks back the way he came.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Ah, man!!
(Atalanta spots such a wizard and runs to him.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: Oh, don't come!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Uncle! You know me, right? Me, me! Take it out.
(The frightened wizard runs like crazy, but is caught up by Atalanta. He does this several times, but eventually Atalanta catches him at a dead end.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Wizard man... . Please save me. You can go out, right? I have to get out. I have to see mom… . please… .

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: Why are you doing this to me... . I, I… . The only crime I committed was because I was told to do it... .
(Atalanta, who was crying at the wizard's words, stops moving. And her shaking eyes also stop moving and stare at the wizard.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: … Atalanta? Now, listen to me for a moment… . Atalanta… ?
(The transparent eyes of Atalanta are filled with the image of a frightened wizard...)
(...As the darkness approaches again, screams echo there.)

steps.name: Ready to go to the capital
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Iris] in the 「Oracle Room」, go to [Dana] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」. 
2. Report the quest to [Narsha] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now open your eyes, %s.
(Iris carefully holds the hand of %s, who cannot speak.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Iris… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is that kid? Why is it there? I think it was definitely called Atalanta... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know either.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But, one thing is certain... . I think the wizard said something when he saw the girl named Atalanta, but I couldn't hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris too? Is it because it's God's name?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think it's probably because it's the name of someone I don't know.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think the reason the girl is there is probably related to the Ministry of Magic. Seeing as Noname knows... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just like Weiss called Deimos before, it seems like they may have set aside a key-like entity... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go to Glaston first. In order for Iris to prepare, I have no choice but to find out first... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Iris. Have you ever been to Glaston?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No. That's all I've heard of the name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . So how do we get there this time? I can't help it. I'll find someone to help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, everything will be okay. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I understand. Then go… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'll be careful, Iris.
(Dana, who was thinking about something with her eyes closed, senses something and looks ahead.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. %s, … I told you to get some rest. Where have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I should report this situation to Iris.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Are you going to Glaston now? It's not yet time... . Is there any new information?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .
(%s, who was hesitating for a moment, hears Iris's voice in his ears.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: It's okay to tell the princess.
(Dana looks around as if she felt something.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. %s, did the goddess come and go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said he wasn't really here and that I could tell him what I saw.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talk to Dana with Iris and tell her what you saw. From Glaston's information not reaching Iris and the spirits to the girl in the underground waterway.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Is that why it was like that? I understand now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The other side is just hard to find. Always been around people.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There were always places like Sanctuary Eidos, which few people visit, and even large villages like Esnir... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The other side of Glaston, the continent's largest city, has not been discovered.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Iris It would be entirely possible if a god-level being like you blocked the information.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That might be possible. Hmm… . Oh, do you know where there is a place that looks like an underground waterway?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Glaston's underground waterway is so large that it's hard to say exactly where it is.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hundreds of years ago, as kingdoms transformed into empires, city plans were drawn up, and sewage maintenance was also included. It's still under maintenance... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I think they said they would just leave waterways that were in such bad condition that they couldn't be repaired.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good information, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's a story everyone from Glaston knows, so it's hard to say it's good information. First of all, where do you go to find it? .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Glaston is not an ordinary city, and you will have to wander around for a while to find the place you remember.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leave that to me. I'll go first and do something.
(Dana looks slightly surprised by %s's momentum. Then she smiles quietly.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. %s. … Now that I think about it, a lot has changed over the years. At first it seemed very complicated... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's not the right time yet, but I have something on my mind and I think I should make a move. Even if it's only for a few days, please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You don't know the way to Glaston, do you? Narsha knows, so let’s go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. uh? Together?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The Magic Agency is regularly checking Narsha's magic golem, and it coincided with that period.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay… ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There is no need to arouse unnecessary suspicion by not allowing Narsha to go. As long as the magicians of the Ministry of Magic are investigating the magic golem, they will not do anything to its owner, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Besides, there are many people behind Narsha. They probably don't know either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Narsha will also like it if %s goes with you. Hurry up and go.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then go to Glaston's main square and look for Sylvia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Argent's younger sister. You'll recognize him right away because he resembles Argent. Just say I sent you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dana. See you later then.

steps.name: Let's go to Glaston
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Narsha] in 「Guild Alliance City Esnil」, go to [Leon] in 「Laran Road」. 
2.  After talking with [Leon], go to “Slum Rashuet Entrance” and report the quest to [Narsha].

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Here the bad fairy met the golem... .
(Narsha is reading a book she once found. She was so focused that she didn't even seem to notice anyone coming nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that book interesting?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's just like that. ah… ? Hello %s.
(Narsha recognizes Adventurer and stands up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're going to Glaston soon?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: How did you know? Ah, you heard from the president. I'm going to the magic office to get Madori checked.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also need to go to Glaston, but I don't know how to get there. Dana said it would be okay if I went with Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow, really? It was difficult for Raclette or Zelic to go with me this time, so I was wondering who would come, and it was Adventurer!
(Narsha somehow looks happy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you were going to the magic office... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Even if I go, I won't do anything special, so it'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I just spoke briefly with a wizard and checked Madori's status.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I check the status?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I tell Madori various things and see if she does what she does. Would you like to raise your arm? Do you want to roll forward? Do you want to jump a little? Do you want to dance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These are some simple things.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The person in charge, Raven Wizard, doesn't even know why he's doing this. Oh, Raven, you are in charge of Madori checks.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Hmm… . Oh, when are you going?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Just leave this book alone. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will be waiting.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You've been waiting a long time, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Okay, shall we go now? It’s been a while since I’ve seen those clothes.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: For some reason, I feel like I have to wear this outfit this time. how is it? Is it weird?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It suits you well. I guess I still like the clothes Minos gave me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I like it, but it also makes me feel stronger. Plus, it was even better that someone similar to me gave it as a gift.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'd like to say hello to Minos again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go together later. You'll love it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Please take me with you.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, when I go to Knossos... . I hope you never see that strange man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . I will. I also feel uncomfortable seeing him for some reason... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer. Did you feel the same way about me?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: To get to Glaston, just go up the Laran Road near the village of Luria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, was there a road there?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You know the saying, no matter where you go, all you have to do is go to Glaston?  There are many roads leading to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And Raven Wizard told me to come on foot. They say they measure accurate data... . I've tried it a few times, but I'm still not sure why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By any chance, have you ever been to the Ministry of Magic after returning from the Orcarium?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No. However, there was one request to visit. The president said he was suspicious and rejected it instead.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He said, “You’re using the princess’s authority like this.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a sudden visit... . hmm… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: When we go to Laran Road, shall we first see Uncle Leon? Uncle Leon chases after the Heffling on the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Narsha know Leon too?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer also knows.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Should I say that although the circumstances are different, they are somewhat similar. Uncle Leon is a complete beastman, and in a way, I too am called a beastman... so... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: We met a few times on the way to Glaston and became close friends. He was a really interesting person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, it's not fun, it's a bit strange... . Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, shall we go now? Did I stay too late?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Okay, shall we go now?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh! Fly? Nalsa, long time no see! Hello, hello to the great %s's room owner %s.
(While Leon is chasing a heffling aiming for a lunchbox, he recognizes the %s group approaching and waves.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uncle Leon, I told you this before. My name is not Nalsa, but Narsha.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Yes, Naru Naru. And I'm not an uncle. I'm only twenty years old.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Narunaru, no, Narsha... . ha. I was giving up halfway, but I guess I should give up too.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehehe, I won. Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leon is still the same. But how do you know the name of that room?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: What room? Room of the great %s? %s's room is beyond great?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouch, stop emphasizing that room name.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I heard that the Nereis Gateway Center accommodation has an unusual name. How did %s come about?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I heard from Grandma Helena that His Majesty the Emperor personally gave the room a name so that %s can rest whenever he comes.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, Your Majesty… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's also an excellent choice.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Did Narurong think so too? As expected, we get along well. Are you going to Glaston today too?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, %s is going with us today.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I hope so. I've never been to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: In fact, even when I get to Glaston, there are almost no places I can go. About a magic office... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Ah… , sorry.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why am I sorry Leon?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Narsha, I’m sorry. I got this foolish thought, thinking, “He’s been to places I couldn’t go.”

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's okay. It's true that I can go to the magic office that Leon can't. So don't think I'm stupid. Oh, are you stupid?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Thank you, I appreciate it, but... . I really feel like I'm being treated like an idiot.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hehe. Stupid Leon.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehe. Stupid Narurongsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nice to see these two people being so close.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehe, stupid %s?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: It's a joke, a joke. Now, on the way to Glaston, I will chase away the heffling that is running towards you asking for food. Please take care of Narsha. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Thanks, Leon.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thanks, Leon. When I come back, I'll buy you the chocolate you said you wanted to eat before.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, really? I'll be waiting for you, Narsha! Goodbye, %s. Now, I'll go after Heffling!
(With those words, Leon chases after the Heffling, which is looking for food.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer. The road to Glaston is over there. Please follow me. Uh, but Leon, can I eat chocolate…? ?

steps.name: Rashuet's Wind
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] at the “Slum Rashuet Entrance” and go to [Daisy]. 
2. After talking with [Daisy], go up to “Glaston Central Square” and report the quest to [Moran].

lines.text: (The appearance of the castle, stretching high into the sky so that it can be seen from afar, gets closer. The distance where the steps stop greets the group with a different atmosphere than the castle seen in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: From here is Glaston. Hey, do you see the castle over there? That is the imperial castle where His Majesty resides.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The area where the tall buildings are located under the Imperial Castle is the administrative district where government offices are located, and underneath it is the central square.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And here… .
(Narsha lowers her head before explaining.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I… , Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Hey, Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you're trying to say. I'm fine, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing happened.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah… .
(Narsha nods her head quietly as if she understands.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I will be at the inn in front of here. I stay here when I come to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If you're resting, Wizard Raven will send someone, follow him and it's over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think it’s dangerous like Narsha said, but….)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Even in Glaston, there are people like the president, Zelic, and Raclette. You can get help from them when you go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Them? Ah, then there will be no problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, did you know what they were doing?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I don't know the details. I just know that it's something a little special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What are you going to do now, Adventurer? You said you had some business to run.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to go see the person Dana introduced me to.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer! See you later. Thank you.
(Narsha says hello to %s and walks toward the building that appears to be the dormitory.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha… , I guess there were a lot of things I wanted to ask… .
(Narsha leaves the place, and only then does %s see the street.)
(Unlike the north, where you can feel a clean atmosphere with a majestic castle, the street where Adventurer stands has a decidedly different atmosphere.)
(Old and shabby buildings, poorly maintained roads, broken signposts, carts, and broken bottles in front of them.)
(There was even laundry hung on a rope between the buildings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like a country village... . Still, if you see a lot of people, it must be a city. There are a lot of people selling things, and lots of kids running around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which way should I go to get to the square? ?
(At that time, a girl is seen holding a guitar in the distance and looking around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I ask that person?
(As Adventurer approaches, the girl holding the guitar greets her with a bright smile.)
If you want to give me a gift, I'll just accept your heart. A letter full of heart is okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A gift? letter? I wanted to ask you something... .
Ah! Hahaha, you're not my fan. Of course I thought he was trying to give me something.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Hello, I'm Daisy! Please feel free to call me Daisy!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: And it's okay if you're not a fan. Ask anything!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I like answering questions. but! If you ask me a mischievous question, I'll hit you with my guitar!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… ? Ah, yes.
(A girl who introduced herself as Daisy holds up a guitar with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get to the central square?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: You weren't curious about me. It's okay though. To get to the central square, just follow the road behind me and go straight up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Daisy.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I need to work harder in the future. Seeing as there are many people who don't recognize me, I guess I still have a long way to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Daisy. Next time, I'll say hello first.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Thank you just for your words. Hehehe. I'll work hard.
Daisy, I'll take this person with me.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I would be grateful if Moran oppa did that.
(A sturdy young man holding a large broom nods and greets.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Nice to meet you. My name is Moran, a ranger from the Plaza Management Department. If you have anything to prove your identity, I might be able to help you further... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… . here… .

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: This is a card certified by the imperial family. %s? ah!

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You are the one who led the Battle of Moros to victory. It's an honor to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Moran, nice to meet you too. But how did you know me?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: He is famous among those working in government offices. I think ordinary residents also know this.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I was about to return to the square after finishing the maintenance of Rashuet, and it just so happened to go well. Please follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Moran. Thank you, Daisy.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: What? It's something I have to do. Ah, Daisy. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Did you know that street performances also require permission from management?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: So I went with the documents and got permission. Look here. By the way, why is something like this in the documents?
(Daisy takes out a piece of paper that appears to be a permission form from her guitar case and shows it to Moran.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: … Sorry, I didn't know there was a pledge not to feed pigeons. But isn't it because I already have a record?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Ahaha… . I only gave you a little bit... . Ratsushi took it all with him... .

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Okay, okay. Don't sing until night falls like before, and go back before the sun sets. Even if the people in your neighborhood like to listen to music, don't do that.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I should have seen the cheerful owls having fun, but it's a shame.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I know that Rashuet is the reason you sing, but that's because it might give Rashuette a hard time.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: In the worst case, there may be talk of blocking street performances in Rashuet as well.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I’ll keep that in mind, Moran oppa.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, you can't do it in a place like a square?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Recently, there was talk at the National Assembly that they were causing noise, so all large-scale performances, including those in the square, were banned.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: There is an open-air theater that can accommodate thousands of people, and there is also an opera house... .

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I don't think it's a noise issue. In the past, even when famous people performed, there was no conversation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Moran oppa, I know you're busy, but let's go after one song. You like my song. %s, %s, please listen to one song as well.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: %s, do you mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also like listening to songs.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You won't regret it.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Daisy, we'll listen in the back and go to the square after one song.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Thank you. Now I'm going to get ready. Just watch right here. Okay?
(Daisy smiles brightly and runs to the place she had planned in advance. Everyone is shouting Daisy's name, no matter when the crowds arrive.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Two, three! hello! It's Daisy!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Wow. Rashuet! It's been a really long time. It's not like everyone has forgotten about me all this time, right? It's okay though. From now on, I will make sure you never forget it!
Sister, you’re so pretty!!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: And did you eat? Ah, listen to my song and eat something delicious. promise!
Promise!!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Ah, the opening remarks got longer today. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Then I'll play the first song.
(Daisy picks up a pick and gently plucks the guitar strings.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: La Chouette La Vita… ♬
(Even though she only sang one verse, the people watching Daisy cheered.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Rashuet La Vita… ♬ Even if you open your eyes or close them. The cheerful owl dreams♪ and sings♩

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Don't try to lock me in a cage♬
(The song, which started out calmly, gradually becomes more passionate, making the listener's heart beat faster.)
Wow... . i love it. I'm going crazy... .

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Isn't that amazing? When I see a child born and raised in Rashuet singing like that without giving up hope... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm lucky to come to Glaston and hear such great music.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Oh, I guess you don’t have to listen to the next song.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to hear one more song, but shall we go?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I'm sorry Daisy, but the next song has a bad title.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: The next song is [I entered an 8-person dungeon, all party members died, I was the only one left alive, and met the boss monster].

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Everyone who knows, sing along!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Let's go now. The square is over there.
(Only after passing through unmaintained roads, narrow alleys, and high stairs in succession does a street with a different atmosphere appear.)
(If Lashuette Street was like a shadow of the city, the newly entered area approaches like the sun shining in the morning sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… .
(A stream of water rises from the Siren Fountain in the center, as if it was waiting for people.)
(Then the rainbow that emerged under the clear and clean sky overlaps the Hwangseong Castle.)
(It feels lively to see many people coming and going in the square for their own purposes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so big. A road here, a road there… .

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: That is the road to the imperial castle and administrative district. This is the residential district and workshop street, and that is... .
(Moran explains the paths of the square to %s, who is busy looking around.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: If you're still not sure, just go in front of the fountain. From there, you can clearly see the roads to other areas.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Well, there you go.

steps.name: Following the rumors in the square
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Moran] in 「Glaston Central Square」 and complete the sub-quest (Noble of the Slums) and (Follow the Flowers). 
2. Once you have gathered all the information, go to the Siren statue and organize the information. Then, report the quest to [Sylvia] in “Glaston Central Square.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was so much to see in the central square that I lost my mind for a while.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Haha, it's okay. Everyone who comes for the first time has the same reaction.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Is there anything else I can help you with? It seemed like you were looking for something... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was looking for someone because I had a favor to do. I heard that it appears often in the square... .

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I think it would be helpful if you told me your name... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, then Sylvia… He said.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Ah, Sylvia. Are you talking about the younger brother of Argent, leader of the Red Moon Scars of the Imperial Knights?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: He was probably a Daisy fan, so he was probably in Lashuette. I think I went to see Daisy because I tend to have a lot of freedom in what I do.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: The time is a bit unclear to bring Sylvia... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Peony. I'll look for it.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Silvia works in a government building close to the square, and often goes outside to rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Moran.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: That's a relief. haha. Ah, the time has already come.
(With those words, Moran takes out glasses and a mask from her arms and puts them on.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: It's time for intensive maintenance at the plaza, so I think I'll have to leave. %s, I hope you have a great time in Glaston.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: If you need help later, please come to me or come to the office on the second floor of the Imperial Environmental Building in the administrative district.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Moran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s been a while since I’ve seen such a kind person….)
(Moran leaves and %s, who is looking around the square again, enters the field of view of the Imperial Castle high up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is the imperial castle where His Majesty resides... . It's white, beautiful, and even majestic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The square is also very pretty. I think it would be nice to just take a walk. however… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does this mean that a divine being of wisdom appears here...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The content of the prediction must be changed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Let's first go around the square and gather information from people. If we gather even small things, we can find out something.)
(The area near the Siren statue erected on one side of the square is quiet. %s's mind becomes complicated, and his footsteps naturally head there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute, I need to sit down and gather my thoughts.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A murderer hiding somewhere in Rashuet, someone's voice coming from the underground waterway of Rashuet...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Noname found in an alley in Rashuet, a suspicious dolphin, a suspicious space floating in the sky in Glaston…. Even the magician of the Ministry of Magic casually mentioned Pandemonium….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s decide which place to go first based on the clues.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then…….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At first glance, there are a lot of alleys in Laschouette... but how long does it take to go around them all?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still have time, but I don't know if I'll be able to find them all... Rumors that I've come to Glaston should have spread by now...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s think of something else….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A specific place where it is not strange even if something suspicious happens... It must be a waterway, after all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The place in the memory shown by Iris was in a waterway, and the voices the children heard were also in a waterway.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm not sure about the rest of the story, but I think I'll need to look into it first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First of all, going to the waterway is going, but I guess I'll have to get help from someone...)
(As %s was thinking like that, the sound of someone singing came to his ears. It seemed like someone passing by was humming a song.)
La Chouette La Vita, La Vita~♪

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, what is this song?)
(It's definitely a song I've heard somewhere, but the humming, off pitch and beat, makes it impossible to recall the original song at all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the daisy song!
(With the shout of %s, a person passing by looks around in surprise.)
That's right. Daisy's song... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I didn’t think it was because it felt completely different… .

(A girl who looks very similar to someone else, with hair as red as the sun, blue eyes, expressionless expression, and even an attractive spot on her face although in a different position, is looking at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'm Sylvia, but do you know me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Dana said that there is someone who looks exactly like Argent... .
(Silvia turns her head briefly and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Princess, no. If that's what Dana said, there's nothing we can do. Please follow me first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is true that magicians from the Magic Agency were involved in everything, but...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There are not enough clues. We can’t go to the Magic Agency with this alone….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If you move incorrectly, Narsha may be in danger...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s think of something else….)

choices.text: 4. I'm hungry. Let’s eat something and do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly just thinking about it makes me hungry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, there was a lot of food that Zelic gave Narsha. I was hungry at the time, so it was good.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ha, I think I'll buy something now.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I’ve eaten, let’s think about it properly….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then…….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At first glance, there were a lot of alleys in Laschouette... but how long would it take to go around them all?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still have time, but I don't know if I'll be able to find them all... Rumors that I've come to Glaston should have spread by now...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s think of something else….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A specific place where it is not strange even if something suspicious happens... It must be a waterway, after all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The place in the memory shown by Iris was in a waterway, and the voices the children heard were also in a waterway.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm not sure about the rest of the story, but I think I'll need to look into it first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is true that magicians from the Magic Agency were involved in everything, but...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There are not enough clues. We can’t go to the Magic Agency with this alone….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If you move incorrectly, Narsha may be in danger...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s think of something else….)

steps.name: Argent's little brother who doesn't listen to him.
steps.objective: After talking to [Sylvia] at “Glaston Central Square”, report the quest to [Narsha] at “Slum Lasuette Entrance”.

lines.text: (Silvia's steps stop on the way from the square to another area. She looks around and looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Do you have time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Sylvia okay?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: It's okay because it's break time. Then let’s talk. I've heard %s so many times that I knew something about it. I was wondering who it was, and this is how I got to meet it.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: If you met Argent, have you also heard my story? Are you saying that I don't listen well again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . He just said he had a younger brother.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Haha… . I talked about it. I did it… . Anyway, since you came here through the introduction of Dana, I will introduce you properly. My name is Sylvia, and I am a scribe at the Archives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Recorder? Scribe?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Since you don't know the recorder, I guess he's from a different region. In fact, if you are not a Glaston resident, neither the recorder nor the scribe will know much about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yes. It is a very small institution and there are only a few people working there. The Record Office is an organization that records the situations that occur in the empire every day in books, magic tools, etc.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: It's been around since the Kingdom of Sylvaria developed into an empire, so it's been quite a while.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I am a copyist whose job is to keep records through writing. It's the lowest of the low, but I'm enjoying it because it's fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! Is there such a thing as a recorder? Something like a map of the waterway in Rashuet or a route to take... .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Of course there is. I guess that's what Dana meant when she told us to help %s.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: It's a secret to Argent over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Why didn't you tell me about the princess? He's the type of person who criticizes me endlessly whenever something about Dana comes up.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: You'll find out later anyway. The key is whose mouth it comes from. It would be okay if Dana or Her Majesty told me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying you would get scolded if it were me or someone else?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yes… , the nagging is too harsh. My friends don't say that. Wow, I talked about Argent at length.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'll go and see if there's any data related to Glaston's groundwater.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sylvia.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Do you know Daisy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I went to Rashuet, I was greeted by Moran. I also saw street performances.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Then, I will organize my work tomorrow and go to the place where Daisy was performing.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: You can wait about this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sylvia.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: If you really appreciate it, please buy me some gelato later. See you tomorrow, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Sylvia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, there’s nothing more I can do today. I guess I should just rest. This is the inn where Narsha is, right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like things are getting easier... .

steps.name: Underground water in slums
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] at the “Slum Rashuet Entrance”, then approach the place where “Daisy” is and meet [Sylvia].  Then, go into “Slum Lasuette” and meet “Ricota.” 
2. After defeating [Ratsi] in “Slum Rashuet,” report the quest to [Ricotta] in “Slum Rashuet.”

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't know you stayed here. I guess work will take some time.
(Narsha takes a piece of bread prepared at the inn and comes out with Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay because I still have some free time. Didn’t Narsha come after work yesterday?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I thought Wizard Raven would send someone and go right away. They asked me to wait a day, so I just rolled around in my room.
(Narsha takes a bite of the bread with her small mouth and smiles brightly as if she is satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I feel better after eating something delicious.
(At that time, a man wearing glasses waves in the direction where the two people are from afar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, do you know that person? It looks like it's greeting us.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh, Raven Wizard?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: … Miss Narsha, it’s been a while… .
(A pale-looking male wizard approaches Narsha looking very tired.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Did you stay up all night again?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: … I found an interesting book... . But how did you know I stayed up all night?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You look incredibly tired.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Narsha, of course, has excellent observation skills. … It's because of this book. This book brings new power from darkness... … .
(A wizard named Raven holds up a book in her arms. While trying to explain the book, she meets the eyes of %s.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: There was a group of people there. Ah, hello. I am Raven, a wizard belonging to the Ministry of Magic. If you don't mind, please tell me your name... .
(At that moment, Narsha suddenly pushes Raven’s back.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I heard you're busy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Miss Narsha? I went to see Narsha and heard that the food here was delicious... . Whoop whoop whoop.
(Narsha suddenly took out a cake that seemed to have been made by Zelic and put it in Raven's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is delicious too. I'll go with Raven. See you later.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Whoop whoop whoop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, bye.
(Narsha hurriedly drags Raven and leaves the streets of Rashuet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess it's Narsha's consideration to not have any contact with wizards...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, this singing voice... ?
(A singing voice heard somewhere resonates on one side of Rashuet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daisy song? Are you performing today as well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, let’s go over there… ?
(Following the dazzling guitar performance, Daisy's clear and clear voice fills one side of Lashuette Street.)
(People who were trying to pass by in the slum Lasuette, wondering what kind of performance it was, stopped when they heard Daisy's singing voice.)
(When Daisy's song ends, everyone cheers, no matter who goes first.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I love you, Daisy!! Daisy is better than flowers!!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: It's not a flower pig, it's a flower daisy. Popstar Daisy!
(Daisy continues the next song with a simple comment. This song is just as powerful as the song she just sung.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's amazing... . I don't know how to express it... .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: It looks like clear and clean glass beads flowing smoothly, right? It's sturdy and lasts a long time! This marble jumps really high! Jump to the end of the sky.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Then, when it falls, it enters my heart... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean, Sylvia?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: A person who sings with such a beautiful voice is even pretty and cute! Every single gesture is so lovely... . Wow… .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: This is Daisy. so… .
(A small smile appears on Sylvia’s face as she explains Daisy.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I was tired of my brother nagging me, so I went out to the square and just sat there blankly, when I heard a heavenly voice coming from somewhere.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: This is it, this is it. The goddess gave me a blessing, so I chased after it and listened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia, you look happy.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'm sorry. Whenever I talk about Daisy, I lose my senses.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: This is the material you mentioned here. From the map of the alley leading to the aqueduct from Rashuet to the aqueduct drawing... .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: You mentioned the story of Rashuet's aqueduct, so I looked for more related records. There was a record of the knights' confrontation with the murderous Gentleman, so I wrote that down as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sylvia. uh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you write all this down? Are you drawing a map too?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: My job was to write and draw, so I was able to do everything. It's a bit disappointing that you only have permission to view it.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Hey… , %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia, why?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Even if you ask me if it's dangerous, I'm sure you'll say no... . My brother is always like that too.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: So don't get hurt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Daisy's busking is over, so I'll go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Take care, Sylvia.
(Silvia greets with a small smile and then hurries up to the square.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a lot of data. Let’s take a look… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The gentleman's story was Manuel. It's almost the same as the story he told. Why is the waterway drawing so complicated? Ah, here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Currently, maintenance of the Rashuet Waterway is possible by entering from the north. It is written that the south side has not been used for a long time and is closed...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The place the kids went down is north, then let’s go south.)
(When trying to walk towards the alley marked on the blueprint and map, someone grabs %s's collar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: %s, I can feel magic from the direction you are going. Come back a little later.
(When I raise my head and look ahead, a shadow that was not visible before is slowly unfolding in the direction of the alley.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be that this shadow is...?)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: There are times when the administrative district where the Magic Agency is located may temporarily shake slightly, like an earthquake. That is a phenomenon where the flow of magical power becomes entangled... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How does Daisy know that?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I'm from Magic Academy Zelenis! It wasn't a good grade, but I know that much.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: The teachers told me that the Magic Agency has something like a powerful magical tool, so the flow of magical energy often surges.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: They say it's not dangerous, but magical power isn't completely safe.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: They said it would disappear quickly, so it would be safer to go after it disappears.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Daisy.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Ah, %s. wait a minute!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Should I tell you this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daisy? It's okay, so tell me.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Yes… . At some point, magic power was concentrated in Rashuet instead of spreading out. It was normal for this to disappear quickly, but the accumulated magic power was still there.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: It was strange. It's not just a gentle flowing magic, it's concentrated and spread throughout Rashuet to the point where I'm constantly concerned... .

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: So, I filed a complaint with the Magic Agency and kept asking them to do something about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: The Magic Agency tried to brush it off as nothing, so I continued to protest. Perhaps they were concerned about the fact that I graduated from a magic academy, so they sent wizards to do something... .

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: There wasn't much change. How long are you going to treat Rashuet like this? .

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: In the end, I spent my own money to make a bunch of magic tools.
(Daisy puts a bunch of things into %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stickers? Oh, it's a daisy face.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Cute, right? This has a reasonable price and has a good feel to it. It's okay because it can be attached lightly.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I think the magic is dissipating a little because the people of Rashuet and the fans are posting here and there. Just a little bit... .

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: If we increase the number of performances a little more and make more stickers and keep putting them up, the strange magic gathered here will dissipate, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, this is the story.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Huh? Are the stickers effective? The magical energy has dispersed more than before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We can go now, right? Daisy, just in case, I'll add some more as I go over to the alley over there.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Would you please? Thank you, %s! I will only trust %s!
(As Daisy hands out stickers to %s, people who see this from afar come in.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Ahhh, wait a minute! Please call the manager! manager! Oh, I didn't have a manager, right? Now, get in line!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Daisy will hand out stickers herself!
(At one word from Daisy, the people who had been confused a moment ago line up in perfect order. The line is so long that it seems to extend all the way to the central square.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected, you’re very popular, Daisy… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, this is not the time to be like this. Let’s go into the alley. The only thing we can do is go in and check.)
(The moment Adventurer's footsteps reach the alley, the shadow that stayed there disappears, scattering an unknown darkness.)
(The Lashuette street I saw at the end of the road through the darkness was definitely a place I knew, but it gave me a different feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no one. Is this the other side...? . Ugh, what is this smell?
(A terrible smell that stings my nose, which I have never experienced before, comes out, and I naturally cover my mouth and nose with my hands.)
(The moment you think the smell has disappeared to some extent, you try to remove your hand, but the lingering scent still remains, causing discomfort.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … This is no ordinary sewer smell. The fact that the smell spreads all over the place is... Under the waterway... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's too late to check the route again... .
(While trying to open the material given by Sylvia, someone appears in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico? Why is Rico here... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … Someone said it was %s.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I will guide you there. I'll go ahead and tell you the details. And what's holding us back until we get there... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … Everyone is an enemy. They come from a world we don't know and consider us enemies.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Since %s has arrived, I feel like I am becoming more alert.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Please follow me.

steps.name: How to Raise the Veil
steps.objective: Talk to [Ricota] in “Slum Rashuet” and report the quest to [Parmilla] in “Slum Rashuet”.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's here.
(A corner of the alley we arrived at following Ricotta. Inside, a large manhole cover can be seen half-open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the road that goes down to the underground waterway. Thank you, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You won't be able to go in right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Now, there is something like an invisible barrier at the entrance to the waterway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .
(As Ricotta said, as he approached the manhole, he was blocked by something and pushed out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just as Rico said. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There must be a way to get down into this space somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I have no choice but to look for it. But Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Rico here?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I already wanted to tell you.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I found out about this place while I was leaving with %s and heading to another area via Glaston.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You probably know a man named Baral, so I’ll just tell you. I was following Baral on the orders of the president and lost it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not long ago, I was in Bayuna Canyon… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Ricotta what I experienced when I saw Baral in Bayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … Baral went there and did that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, can you elaborate a little more?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, %s.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Baral, who already had a record, was wandering around the underside of the Continent of Freios.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There are many places he has already visited.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then, when I saw that it was heading to Glaston, I followed it and was able to meet a side that I had not seen before.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Why hasn't the other side of Glaston been seen for a while? If it were the normal side, I would have been able to discover it before... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like the other side of Glaston is now under the control of a being that transcends humans... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes? wait a minute. Because it's not organized well... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Wait a minute, then I didn't discover the other side, and I missed the point... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Baral was looking for something in these streets, could that have something to do with it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There will be. maybe… . I think what Baral wants is power.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A power that transcends humans... . I became evil to get that.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That's stupid.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He must have come here because he heard something from the magician.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A wizard?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Baral met a wizard in front of the magic office... . Ah, %s. Someone is coming from over there. fizzle. quietly.
(As Ricotta hurriedly hid behind the building, following the gesture, the voices of two people walking towards somewhere could be heard quietly and clearly.)

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: Captain, is this right?

lines.speaker: 소녀의 목소리
lines.text: If you go this way, you'll be right.

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: I came here believing only the demon horse that made a strange noise called mumu... . Why is it like this here? It's definitely Rashuet, but why are there monsters... .

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: I guess I should say it's fortunate that the monsters don't recognize us.

lines.speaker: 소녀의 목소리
lines.text: Shhh, let's be quiet. If you keep talking, I'll throw you inside that monster.

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: I will be quiet.

lines.speaker: 소녀의 목소리
lines.text: Do you trust me?

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: … I followed because I believed in it.
(As the two people move further apart, the conversation can no longer be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is a voice I heard somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, let's go after those two guys.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since he came in like that, he probably didn't come for a general purpose... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There are more enemies over there than here, so be careful. I will take the lead.

steps.name: A space preparing for destruction
steps.objective:
1. After speaking with [Parmilla] in 「Slum Rashuet」, defeat [Gnosis] within 「Border of Deficiency」. 
2. Then go outside and report the quest to [Parmilla] in “Slum Rashuet.”

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's here, Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Lungs... Okay. I don't know if there's anything like the demon said.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There must be something. Almost everything Daniel said so far was correct.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: To so obediently give information that is more trustworthy than humans... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's okay because I'm safely in Invernell now.
(Parmilla approaches an abandoned house that looks like it might collapse at any moment. Then, she quietly raises her head and mutters in a low voice.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is the boss here…? .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone?
(Parmilla turns her back on Calone, who seems surprised to see someone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Two people, why are you here… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, these people must be… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico knows too. These two people are Parmilla and Calone, leaders of the Oscuras mercenary group.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Mr. Calone is a private magic research institute... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't know how you know, but that's my past... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There was no separate notice of dismissal sent. Then you are still part of the research institute.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Yeah, well... On the surface, yes.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Since he's still being dispatched, if something happens to the mercenary group, Calone can step back for a moment.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Commander, what did you say... . Do I seem like such a heartless person?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You two, don't fight... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, we're not fighting.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I'm not fighting!!

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I heard that the information obtained from the demons was accurate. What were you two looking for?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's a long story, but would you like to also listen to the Moonlight section?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You also know Moonlight. So let’s listen… ?
(Parmilla explains to Ricotta and %s why she came here.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's why I came here.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I need to organize things for a moment. So, Parmilla. You can find what others can't see, hear, or find?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah. that's right. And don't worry, I'm not a witch or anything.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Before I got to know %s, or more precisely, until I got involved with Calone, I tried to live quietly as the leader of a mercenary group.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There were too many coincidences to happen like this, so I went out myself, and with Mr. Calone, we searched for clues... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: How we came this far... , right… ?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Hey, Moonlight friend. You organize things well. As a result, I also found a witch.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: For some reason, I feel like I need to talk to %s. The two feel similar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hilda….)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: One day, my pretty brother came to me and paid me to find a witch on the run. Ah, such a pretty oppa… ? Oh wait… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No, it was the older sister with rabbit ears... . Uh, who was it? Calone, remember?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Well, I don't know. I don't remember... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We were always together, why don't I remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If it's Daphne, it's definitely possible.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: But the interesting thing is, if you find it, give that witch a choice.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Are you going to follow me or keep running away?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It's an option that no one seems likely to follow, but... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, that's why the witch didn't follow. If you don't follow along, the request is automatically canceled.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: But if the witch had followed you, where would you have taken her?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Haha, I don't know. I don't remember. Still, I'm glad I didn't forget something important.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Actually I'm looking for someone. Not only that person, but many others have disappeared from everyone's memories.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: However, only a few people remember.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I remember, but why is there a world that other people don’t remember? . ha… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, after hearing that there was an accident at the Orcarium, I went there because I thought I could find something. The Magic Agency wizards weren't killed for no reason.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then I met Daniel, a demon reporter. Mumu.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, a reporter from the monthly Rosengarten editorial department?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, reporter parrot. I told him to give me information if he didn't want to die, and he gave me some good stuff.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, you know everything to some extent, right? A story about witches. A witch is gathering other witches... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Aaron, the council president, is trying to use a witch... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And the place where the disappeared people headed was Glaston.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I was suspicious because he was a demon, so I checked a few things Daniel said, and everything was correct.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: After meeting and listening to the stories of people who alone remembered the disappeared person, Daniel's information was confirmed.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That abandoned house in Rashuet Alley seems strange, but I haven't gone in. I came because they said it could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: They say it's good because even weak demons can easily come to a place like this.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … Behind the scenes, demons and demons also come in. I too am affected by the twisted shadow... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: If… . It's unfamiliar, but I think it's understandable.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Since we've come this far, let's go in together. Aren’t these two people here with a purpose?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I followed the two people... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, what should I do? If the parrot reporter's information is accurate, there might be something here... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Aren’t three better than two, four better than three?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s, please. I have a feeling that the leader will get into trouble, so I hope you'll join us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … all right. Anyway, Rico and I were looking for a way to get to the blocked waterway. Maybe this place might be the answer.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you, %s. I won't follow the waterway.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You two, I will stand in front, so please follow me. %s will take care of your back.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Thank you very much. Ricotta.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Just call me Rico.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thanks, Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s go in properly prepared….)
(Just like that, the four people push the half-open door of the abandoned house and go inside one by one.)
(Finally, the moment Adventurer takes a step forward, a light so intense that it stings the eyes suddenly approaches at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it’s dazzling… .
(I raise my arms to cover my face, but the intense light still approaches. As I walk a few more steps, an unknown silence approaches, as if no one is around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is everyone okay?
(No sound is heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico? Rico!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla, Calone. If anyone has any answer please reply!!
(When I lower my raised arm, only deep darkness remains in the space where the light has receded. It seems like there is nothing I can see in the space that is still filled with silence.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It certainly looked like an ordinary house inside... . uh?
(He just tried to take a step forward, but %s's body tilted and he fell endlessly to the bottom, which was not even the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaa!! Falling!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If it falls like this, it should hit the floor with a loud sound...)
(With the feeling of not falling anymore, %s's closed eyes naturally open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this… .
(What comes into view is Glaston, full of yellow light, but it looks different from what I know.)
(The Glaston above flipping over in the air, the Glaston below sending debris down as if it had flipped over.)
(The world where two cities face each other from above and below weighs down Adventurer with a truly strange atmosphere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have I entered another world? Could it be that I am alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico!! Parmilla!! Calone!!
(No matter how much I looked around or shouted, there was only one person standing in this strange world, %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no one… . Where on earth are we? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(As %s speaks, a large flame appears among the remains of the building in front.)
(The flame gradually changes into a human shape, creating a sphere filled with light of various colors around it. It then slowly approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are you saying? Surely that is….)
(The being transformed from the flame strokes the sphere and quietly looks at %s's face.)
It will sound right from now on. Now we speak the language of Etoire. Are you a visitor who has set foot on this border?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Border? So who are you?
Isn't there any information here? Then I will explain.
This space is a place awakened by the wish of someone who seeks destruction. It has appeared in worlds other than Etoire and turned everything into nothingness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth are you talking about?
Visitors from other worlds came here to protect their own world. This is because I believed that the method created by the person who wanted destruction was here.
The visitor held on and tried to save his world, but he died while trapped here, watching the world's destruction.
In this boundary between life and death, destruction and continuity, the visitor's death becomes the star's end.
In this way, the fate of destruction embraced by the stars heads toward the end of eternity.
Then I, Gnosis, fall asleep again. When a star appears where the history of destruction begins again, it approaches and waits for visitors.
This concludes the explanation.
(The being who appears to call himself Gnosis steps back and stares at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that means I'm a visitor?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Maybe it's because I've escaped the many beckons of destruction, but it's easy to understand. A visitor from Etoire.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I, Gnosis, do not want you to do anything here. I want to fall asleep, feeling helpless, watching this boundary disappear.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Visitors who hold out and endure will see the end of a star they do not want to see.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A world that rained fire and burned down without a trace. A world where rough waves cover the earth and sweep away everything. A world where the earth split in half and swallowed everything.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: What destruction do you want?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who wants destruction in this world?! Do you think that makes sense?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: There is. That is why I, Gnosis, am here. Etoire is torn to pieces... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it!! I don’t want to hear it!!

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A being who enters from a world full of want cannot leave the boundaries of perfection. So far, no visitor has ever gone outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going out. I have to go out!! I already have a lot of work to do, but I can't do this here.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Is that so? Do you really want to get out of this border of want?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Even if you have a lot to do, it ends here. I'm sorry, but I, Gnosis, want visitors to take it all in.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: By the way, visitor %s… . What is your world? already… ?
(In an instant, the spheres of light of various colors circling around Gnosis stop. Then, one by one, they attach to him and coalesce into a large flame.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What happened to my world?! If you keep saying strange things... .

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I, Gnosis, have something to check for visitor %s. Are you curious about that too?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Then… .
(Gnosis turns into a large flame and watches as the remains of the destroyed building rise upwards.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I hope you find me, Gnosis, somewhere on this border. Well then... .
(With those words, the flame of Gnosis flies far into the horizon and disappears.)
(Then, the beings that had not been seen until now appear one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It won't work out the way you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to live... , There is a reason to live. Even for that reason... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to get out of here... .
(The energy of destruction pouring down on the visitor who has reached the border of deprivation gradually disappears. And in the midst of it, the being who told me to look for him stands there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gnosis.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Visitor %s, are you here? I, Gnosis, speak again.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I don't want you to do anything here. I want to fall asleep, feeling helpless, watching the disappearance of this boundary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anyone who has come this far who has made that choice?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I don't think there was one. They fought against Gnosis until the end and died. Writhing in pain, he watched his world disappear.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I, Gnosis, make this suggestion to help you forget even such pain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's noisy. What do you want to find out from me? I told you to come find me if you're curious about the contents.
(Gnosis quietly gazes into the distance. He then raises the orb into the air.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Visitor %s declined the offer. That means if your will is stronger than mine that controls space, you will know when you defeat me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the end, that's it... .

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: You won't find out.
(Several lights around it flow into the orb that Gnosis is holding. It then turns black and begins to emit an ominous energy.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Before then, the abyss will swallow everyone... .
(The blackened orb gradually disperses like dust. Gnosis, who tried to move by giving the orb other powers, stops moving.)
(After checking the state of the orb, Gnosis extends his hand. Then, an unknown force binds the feet of %s who is trying to attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… ?
(The border of lack that filled %s's vision gradually loses its light. Then, Gnosis rises into the air and looks at the surroundings as well as %s.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: They are felt in your will. I fell as I watched the destruction of the world I loved... .

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: They are gone, but their will remains, helping the visitors who come to save them from their next doom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t know who it is, but thank you for fighting with me….)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Their will is with you. So I blocked the power of Gnosis that controls this space.
(Little by little, the spark of Gnosis spreads on the wind across heaven and earth, and attaches itself to everything in existence except the visitor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to do?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: The moment I, Gnosis, turn to ashes, I will know. Before that, the space where their will remains is purified with flame.
(With one word from Gnosis, the flame begins to burn everything around, little by little, except for %s.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I, Gnosis, do not die. However, at this moment, it just disappears. If another moment of destruction comes, I will wake up and come again.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I came to this planet a while ago, but I couldn't reach it. Because even then you pushed back the moment of destruction.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: It may have appeared as a space named Purgatory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, even this is what the old man wants, right?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Just because you're out of this space doesn't mean it's over. The star's fate of destruction is trapped in the infinite bondage it created and will last forever.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Even if I, Gnosis, leave, the energy of destruction remains and awakens.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Pleroma, a world of destruction created by gathering all of humanity's own feelings of deficiency. Even the demon god Demiurge was sleeping inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demiurge the devil?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A demon god who denies all living beings.

lines.speaker: %s
