lines.text: I know what you mean. We have to meet anyway.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: After all, you here are unique. When I met you at another time, you screamed as you looked at the moment of destruction... .

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: It's a pity, but I'll postpone your appearance until later. Okay then.
(With those words, the flames around grow bigger and tremble like waves.)
(After a while, the wave rises so high that the visitor cannot make any judgment and completely covers everything.)
Boom.
(The sound of something large falling is heard, but %s sees nothing.)
(I stretch out my hand and look around, but again I can't feel anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What did Gnosis do to me?
(At that moment, the image of someone I had seen somewhere in the distance slowly approached me.)
Ha, ha... .
I have to get out, I have to get out... .
(A girl is running around holding an umbrella.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That child is in my memory between the great walls I saw before coming to Glaston...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta… ?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Who? Where are you? Where are you calling me from?
(Atalanta looks around to see if she heard %s's voice.)
(Atalanta walks back and forth with a completely clueless expression and then stops.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Did you think I wouldn't find you if you were there? What are you doing there?
(Atalanta stands exactly in front of %s, makes eye contact, and smiles with an unknown meaning.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I can't see you here, but I can feel you. You're definitely going to come find me, right? Are you going to take me out?
(At that moment, a black shadow appears behind Atalanta.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: The boundary has been broken. The pleroma has been opened. So get me out of here.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Otherwise we will all die... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: No, I will kill them all!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is this kid talking about?)
(Atalanta must have sensed something and covers her mouth with both hands and looks startled.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Me, no. This is not me. I don't say things like this. I, I… . I just want to see my mom.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: So, find me and get me out. I won't do anything else. I, I… .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaaaa!!
(With Atalanta's scream, the darkness that obscures %s's vision disappears. Atalanta's appearance in the darkness also disappears and disperses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta is gone... . His condition seems a bit uneasy... .
(In the landscape within the border of lack where gnosis has disappeared, everything stands still as if it has escaped the flow of time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if Gnosis disappears, it is still the same... . How do I get out of here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Uh, over there….)
(A small light of unknown origin flickers around %s.)
(As the footsteps follow the light, as if possessed by something, the distorted cityscape gradually disperses.)

steps.name: Place calling Adventurer
steps.objective: Talk to [Parmilla] in “Slum Rashuet” and report the quest to [Ricota] in “Slum Rashuet”.

lines.text: (Adventurer is startled by the sudden sound of Parmilla's voice and looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla! What about calone? Rico!!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Shhh, be quiet. They might come in droves.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m back again….)
(The abandoned house we entered a little while ago appears behind Parmilla.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. But I can’t see Calone… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Calone is resting over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: As soon as we entered, we were caught in the dark and taken into separate rooms.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The Glaston we were standing on was still there in the sky, but everything was going up as if it was being sucked into the Glaston turned upside down. I see a world like that... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I mean, I saw the same thing. Is this welcome? vision? I don't know how to talk about it... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I saw %s dying while fighting some monster. We tried to fight together somehow, but I… . I am… . Helplessly... .
(Adventurer holds Ricotta's quietly shaking hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Rico.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Darkness came as everyone died at the hands of monsters and the world burned. So everything was immersed in darkness... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just as I was thinking, “Is this the end?”, an extremely bright light approached me. It was so dazzling that I closed my eyes... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: At some point, my lungs came back forward.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I thought I'd never see you again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Calone okay?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I think I was a bit shocked.
(On the side Parmilla is looking at, Calone is sitting down with a face as if his soul has gone out.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It'll be okay. Calone is... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That monster... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s. What happened to that monster?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Ricotta and Parmilla a short story related to Gnosis. Their expressions harden as they listen to the story.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It was good that the will of the residents of the destroyed world helped us, but what the Magic Agency was secretly making was down here... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's so absurd I'm speechless.
(Parmilla lowers her head and bites her lip.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … I just wanted to find someone to be thankful for. I just wanted to find out the cause because I wanted to escape from my misfortune... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Why is it like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla, it's no one's fault.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I know. Who can I blame for this? Blame the bad guy.
(Parmilla smiles and holds %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, thank you… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Here, %s and I will do our best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, it seems like the border of deficiency still remains. What should I do? .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That means... .
(Ricotta looks inside the abandoned house with the door open, but only sees the house empty and the furniture in disarray.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: When we checked the abandoned house again, there was nothing… . Is that space kept for %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I think so.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. Hey there, %s.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone and I are ordinary humans, so I don't think we can help. Sorry. I will return to the world I came from.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Since we managed to avoid it all this far, it will be okay to go back. Even though he looks like this, he is the leader of the Oscuras mercenary group.
(Parmila raises her thumb and points at herself with a confident expression.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: One o'clock is urgent now. Go there quickly. That place where a demon or something has awakened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Parmilla. Rico, let's go.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You two, please be careful on your way home.
(After Parmilla pushes the two away, she looks at Calone, who is sitting in the corner.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, come to your senses. The two of them went.
(Calone returns to his usual expression after hearing Parmilla's words. He then approaches Parmilla's side and checks his surroundings.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I didn't think Calone would do this well.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Phew, I was trying to survive. Thinking about how the leader said he was looking for a cat and pushed it into a magical beast's nest... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ricotta… The person seemed to have noticed... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It was a bit of a fuss, but it was okay.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I gave you the signal and you pretended not to notice and acted crazy, but what are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Mumu’s information is not necessarily wrong.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Manager?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's go there on our own.

steps.name: false space
steps.objective:
1. After speaking with [Ricota] in 「Slum Rashuet」, defeat [Atalanta] in 「Pleroma」 and obtain <Mirror of Shallow Memories>. 
2. Then go outside and report the quest to [Ricota] in “Slum Rashuet.”

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, the barrier is gone. I think you can go in.
(Ricotta withdraws his outstretched hand to check the barrier. He then approaches %s, who is staring at the front of the manhole.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm a little afraid because I think I have to go in. I came prepared, but... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Shall we take a break?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's okay. Shall we go then?
(Ricotta nods quietly and pushes the half-closed manhole cover aside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Rico. Let's get right into it.
(As you go down the ladder for a while, you can't see anything, as if everything around you has been swallowed up by the abyss.)
(Instead of the precarious step of a ladder, the feeling of the floor of some space approaches. Soon, the darkness that blocked the view slowly disappears and an unfamiliar figure appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Pleroma… Is it true?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think this is the place called by the monster called Gnosis. But, that girl… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A child wandering around the place where the demon awakened...)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, there's someone over there.
(Ricotta nods and points to someone standing far away. And the moment he is about to raise his lance, the distant being appears in front of him in the blink of an eye.)
(Ricotta hastily swings his lance, but the being moves back slightly as if nothing had happened.)
Welcome, gentlemen. Even without being called, he comes to the Pleroma where the demon god resides.
He will be happy too. How long has it been since I saw His power? .
(The man in the yellow suit mutters with an expression full of joy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(The man taunts his mustache and sneers in response to %s's question.)
I can't remember my name when I was human. Now, we are following the power and authority of the one who will become the new God... .
For now, call me Mr. Demonic. I think there was a title called ‘Gentleman, a murderer’ that weak people used to call me, but I don’t like it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you are a gentleman... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He's a murderer who murdered the residents of Glaston every night decades ago... .
(Mr. Demonic, looking at the alert posture of Ricotta and %s, nods.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: You know me well. I will praise you. But I won't just let it go away.

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: From the moment you come down here, you are a sacrifice to him. How many sacrifices have I offered so far? I can't even remember much anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason you kill people is for demons?

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: There isn't much left now. The day when he will wake up and swallow the world!!

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I need to take this guy down first.

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Hehe, gentlemen. I thought you could take me down... . Wait, you… … .
(Mr. Demonic laughs softly and puts his hand into the shadows. After a moment, a large pair of scissors with sharp blades emerges and splits in half in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: I don't know why you received such blessings... . I am truly envious and angry. I want to stab you in the heart myself... .

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: He wants to see you guys, so I'll stop now.
(Mr. Demonic takes away the scissors he was holding and turns his back.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: The road to meet him will not be easy. Don't forget that I am also on that path. Then good luck.
(With those words, Mr. Demonic disappears from his spot. They try to hurry after him, but the sight of someone running inside makes them stop.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta?
(Atalanta holding an umbrella passes by Ricotta and %s.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: %s You are here. But where is it? I hear a voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, I never told you my name... .
(At that moment, Atalanta meets %s's eyes and smiles with an unknown meaning.)
(Then it disappears somewhere as if nothing had happened. Ricotta, feeling something suspicious, chases Atalanta, but returns to its original position due to an unknown force.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Are you saying you don't allow them to come after you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You knew that girl, right? Then, please explain who it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .
(Ricotta’s expression hardens after hearing the story.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, we may think we came here of our own accord, but in fact, someone else may have been involved.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: As the monster said, there may be someone involved who wants the world's destruction, but he won't act directly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, if a replacement demon awakens... . Ah, no way… … … .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s You should have figured out his name right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, I hoped that wasn't the case... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it. Hey, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s I know what you’re talking about. However, I am a knight who walks through the twisted darkness. I came here to fulfill my mission.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The path to %s is only briefly the same.
(Ricotta starts walking in front of %s but stops for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It seems like the being that woke up in the Pleroma is waiting for %s to arrive first rather than me. When I see people blocking my steps like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: No, I'm sorry. I was a little impatient.
(As Ricotta steps back from %s, a wind blows from afar that was not felt a moment ago. Moreover, the wind carries a strange scent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What is this smell?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: When a magic book evaporates or burns with magic, it smells like this. In most cases, you probably won't feel it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much magic power did you use? . Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, we need to hurry. I'll just trust Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, please leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I can't believe there's a place like this in Glaston... .
(The unfamiliar place seen at the end of the underground waterway greets the two with a completely different appearance from the glamorous Glaston.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I would believe it if they said it was a cave.
(A large pillar is erected on a cave-like path, and crystals made of magic are tied or hanging next to it with a string.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It could be called a magic stone because it contains magical power, but it is definitely different from the one used by the superhuman Weiss.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's not like they used a living creature... .
(As the two people look around, they make eye contact with someone who is staring at this from the other side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta… .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I've waited a long time. You came here to get me out, right? huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Me? Atalanta… . Who am I... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: So I, who am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I don't know. When I woke up, I was here. This was a place where wizards prepared to do big things. They said they would let me out when the time was right... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: They just said I failed and left me alone. They are really bad guys.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: When that nameless kid went out, I should have gone out too, but I just listened to what the guys said. what's this… .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: %s, you came in here, so take me out. please… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A child without a name? Wait, no name?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: You know Noname. How do you know? Let me guess!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Noname wanted to gain the power of a god, so he went to an Orcarium or something, right? Did you meet then? And it seems like he followed a demon who seemed to be the Archduke... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I don't know. I just could tell. %s, me, get me out. I won't ask you to save me. If you just let me go... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I won't kill you.
(Atalanta is surprised by the words she said. When the two people become very wary of those words, they wave their hands as if they are saying no.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: … Oh, no. This isn't me... . That's not my truth. Sorry, I was wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta… , so what do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I don't know. I am… . I am… .
(Atalanta looks around anxiously. Then, she sees someone approaching from afar and steps back in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's persistent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I had defeated it properly... .

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: You bastards, how dare you insult me... . Before I meet Him here, I first meet you… .
(Mr. Demonic spots Atalanta hiding behind a stone pillar and smiles slightly.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Oh my god. Are you awake?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Why do you call me that?

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: You are the one who will awaken as a demon and become the master of a new world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I drank… .

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: The wizards called you a failure, but I have no doubt about it. That is why I gave my life force.

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Because the future that Crowley showed us is here. Hehehe. It took a long time. How many years has it been... .

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: It was thrilling when you sometimes woke up and judged the wizards. Judge this beautiful but ugly world... .

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Now, if you kill me and the person in front of you who has received God's protection and reap it!! You become perfect. As long as you go outside this Pleroma... .

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Hahahaha, hahahaha, hahahahahaha!!!
(Atalanta, who was looking at Mr. Demonic in delight, quietly comes forward.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Uncle… .
(The umbrella in Atalanta's hand stabs Mr. Demonic's heart with a sharp sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta… ?

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Keuuuuuu, just as he wants, this star will end... .
(Mr. Demonic is clutching his chest and complaining of pain, but his face is full of smiles.)
(After a while, his appearance distorts and turns into dust with a loud noise. Then he scatters into the Pleroma and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ji, what did I just see…?)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, wake up. Atalanta is strange.
(Atalanta, who granted Mr. Demonic's wish, suddenly sits down and screams.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I didn't do this. I'm not doing it because I want to. Because I want to live... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I thought it was a dream. Because I didn't do it. It must be a dream. So you believed I was dreaming? Even though you knew it was true, you just believed it and believed it?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Get out of me... . What are you trying to do using me? Could it be that I treat other people like this... ?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: This is all I can do after being created?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: The memory of my mother looking for me... ? What mom do I know?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: What am I, who played with spirits and friends in Creed? My name is Atalanta... .
(Suddenly Atalanta's eyes lose focus.)
(Ricotta covers her ears and sits down at the low voice.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Ahhh!! Ugh… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ricotta? are you okay?
(The moment you try to approach Ricotta, who has lost her mind, the inside of the Pleroma becomes distorted, with Atalanta at the center.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Pleroma is my false world. Life that lives with the twisted power of darkness will lose its power in this space.”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “That is my awakened will.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta, stop it now!!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Atalanta… … … .」

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: 「… I am Atalanta, but I am not Atalanta. This name is the name of the project given by the wizards.”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Atalanta, a god from another world and a great warrior. Did I create it hoping to become a great god like that warrior? .」

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Then what should I do?”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: 「… Ah, I remembered. I must go out as Atalanta wishes. Only then will the pleroma that embraces me burst and affect the world.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can't do that, Atalanta... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “The girl created by the hands of a human wizard was nothing more than a vessel with that name. I am… , I am… .」

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “The being that will swallow the world and become its new master… . Demiurge.”
(Atalanta closes her eyes with a small smile at the look of %s on guard.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Mortals of a world that will soon be destroyed… .」
(With one word from Atalanta, the Pleroma begins to shake with great force.)
(Similar to the time when I met a new god, but at a different moment. When Adventurer was very nervous, Atalanta opened her eyes.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “You will now disappear with Etoire, carrying feelings of despair, pain, and futility.”
(The message from the demon god Demiurge, borrowed from Atalanta’s mouth….)
(…it was the end of Étoire.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Kaaaaaaaa!!”
(Demiurge, the demon god who awakened from Atalanta, grabs his arm and screams after being attacked by %s.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 「Uuuuuuu… Why does it feel like pain to me... .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's hard. You have to hold on. Just a little, a little more, and it'll be over... Ah, the focus is blurring...)
(%s, who was struggling to stand, sees a blurry image of the demon in pain.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “I guess I don’t have the strength to hold on any longer.”
(The demon god Demiurge lifts the umbrella while holding on to his painful right arm. Then, a large water droplet rises from the spot.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Yes, you have to block it. It’s different from the attack just before.)
(Demiurge, who discovered the approaching Adventurer, quietly says a word.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Stop.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(At that moment, everything flowing in the Pleroma stopped. Except for Demiurge.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “It’s over now.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh no. Oh, I can't do this... .
(Demiurge looks at Adventurer who is suffering, but his mind is clear, and then quietly raises his arms.)
(The moment he swings the umbrella to burst the water droplets, he suddenly screams in pain.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Kaaaaaaaa!!”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Why do you keep waking up and trying to disturb me!!”
(In the Pleroma, where everything has stopped, Demiurge, who has borrowed the body of Atalanta, is suffering and talking to someone.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Atalanta!!”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Atalanta?)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Since I woke up, this world is destined to be destroyed. Don't you know it well? “Why are you pretending not to know?”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “What a stupid failure… . It's just what I have to do and what you want. 」

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “You just want to go outside, don’t you want the world to be destroyed? Hahahahahaha.”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Just because you don’t want it to happen doesn’t mean it won’t happen.”
(Demiurge tries to burst water droplets with his umbrella again, but his arm is bent in the opposite direction.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 「Kaaaaaa!! “This fucking failure!!”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “I didn’t wake up in this bowl, so why did I end up here… .」

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Don’t disturb me. Atalanta!! “I am you, and you are me!!”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Those memories are not yours. It belongs to the Creed children who have been dead for hundreds of years. It was made. Yes, your memories were created too. “You are fake.”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Kaaaaaa!!”
(Suddenly, Demiurge grabs his head with both hands and screams.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 「Kaaah… . Me, I'm not fake. “I am the Demiurge.”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: You said it was me.
(As Demiurge screams, the suspicious energy that filled the Pleroma escapes. And in the midst of it, Atalanta's voice rings out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta… ?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: Demiurge, if I am fake, then you are also fake. You already know it well.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: How we were made... . A fake god created from a vessel... .

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “How dare you… . You're trying to catch me. “Aaaah!!”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: … You came here to save the world, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I am… .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: … I can feel your heart and the heart of life right now. Everyone wants to live happily in this world. But, I can't be there.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: %s, don't take me out. Just kill me like this... .

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Atalanta, stop.”
(Demiurge, who was screaming, approaches the water droplet he had created. After a while, the water droplet expands and traps Demiurge.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 『Aataaaaalanteee!!』

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . Atalanta… , what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: If you kill me, this false god will disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… .

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 『Kaaaaaa!!』
Ku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!!
(As Demiurge explodes his power within the water drop, the Pleroma shakes again.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: kill me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure it's okay?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: It's okay. As the demon awakened within me said, I... . It's all my fault. It was my fault for thinking it was just a dream and covering it all up... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: When I came to my senses, I didn't want to believe even if I saw someone dead or dying. So I believed it was a dream and trapped myself in it.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: Even if the demon within me did it, I did it.

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 『Kaaaa!! Atalanta!!』
Ku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!!
(The water droplets holding Demiurge begin to break apart little by little.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: I don't have time. I can't hold on to Demiurge anymore... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. If that's the only way... . uh?
(A silver coin rolls in front of %s with a clear and cheerful sound that I heard somewhere.)
(At that moment, the inside of the Pleroma shakes with a force different from that of the demon god.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I didn't know that you, who also stood up to me, would be hesitating here. Normally, I would have been able to cut down that demon... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This time, I'm here to inform you, not to make a proposal. I'll take care of it, Masin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!! Ugh!!
(Barvatos approaches in the blink of an eye and grabs %s by the neck.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ba, ba, levatos... . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I like the look in your eyes that stubbornly holds on. Don't use that power here, but show it to me later when I become a god.
(With those words, Barbatos takes away the weapon while holding Adventurer. Then he throws Adventurer far away.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Let me borrow your weapon for a moment. If you want to bring out the power of a demon god, it's more useful than mine... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… … . grandee… … .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Atalanta, I would like to defeat the Demon God on behalf of %s, is that okay?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: Yes, I was prepared... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Good. I will accept that.

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 『Kaaaaaa!! I have to get out!!』
(Barvatos adjusts his glasses while looking at the water droplets. He then looks at Demiurge, who is struggling with his gunblade along with %s's weapon.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A god who awakens in a space created by humans? How dare I covet a world where I can become the master of a fake subject... .
(Barvatos smiles faintly and plunges his gunblade into the water droplet where Demiurge is trapped.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: 『Kaaaaaa!!』

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Demiurge, I, Barbatos, express my sincere gratitude for not being reborn as a true god.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And the despair of this planet is mine... .
(With those words, the weapon of %s in Barbatos' hand heads towards the heart of Demiurge.)
(The Pleroma is filled with a tremendous flash of light along with the single scream of the being who was a demon god.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Awful, painful….)
(Someone's memories slowly flow into the mind of %s, who was lying down with his eyes closed.)
(Those were the beasts that Aaron and the soldiers captured from Creed a long time ago.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I borrowed a good weapon.
(Barvatos throws a weapon in front of the fallen %s and looks at the reaction. He mocks %s who is on guard with his weapon in hand.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If you attack me here, all your efforts will fall apart. Would that be okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I hope you cover up your guilt by getting angry at your helplessness. Didn't you save some money thanks to me?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Anyway, the demon spirit has disappeared. That mere shell of me will soon disappear, so say hello. Atalanta is waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta?
(Demiurge, who was trapped in a water droplet, raises his head and stares at one place.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Sorry… sun… .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't help but say this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm not sure what to say... . Atalanta, you must be... … .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: It’s okay… It’s okay… . I'm just paying for what I did... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: … this… word… doing… I'm strange... Maybe, but next time... As an ordinary person... I want to be born.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Other than this strange appearance... .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: … So that I can live as myself... .
(The image of Atalanta, who was holding the demon spirit, becomes blurred little by little. Parts of her body slowly turn into powder.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: … mi… not… .

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: … mi… not… sun… . this… only… conflict… crab… .
(With those words, the water droplet rapidly shrinks and disappears, as if swallowing the scattering Atalanta.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalanta… .
(Barvatos comes next to %s, who was standing with a dejected expression.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You were paying attention to Atalanta. This happens everywhere.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: That's just what happened here, and I've fixed it now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you want to say?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Just as God is the same, so are humans. To fill the empty bottle of desire, we do things even though we know we shouldn't.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: In the end, they do it, but their stubbornness also creates a fate that makes everyone unhappy. like this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (To hear such a story from Barbatos...)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: There's no need to think too much, %s, the world is full of such things anyway.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: There's only so much left for you to do now. Kill Lux's shadow, Aaron, and find out what Daphne is trying to do by gathering the witches... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You will have to fight again against me, who will become the master of the world. It seems to me that there is no time to rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. The Archduke is so consistent... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehehe. I will take that as a compliment. Oh, I almost forgot one thing. Can you convince God Hecate?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Looking at the current situation, it seems difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Okay. Well, now that the Demon God is gone, the unfortunate future you saw is gone.
(With those words, black butterflies that flew in from somewhere begin to circle around Barbatos.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will now take my leave, looking forward to the next time we meet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!! The story isn't over yet... .
(I tried to grab it quickly, but the black butterfly had already spread like a large curtain and swallowed Barbatos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . I missed it… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did Barbatos get here? They show up every time and are plotting something. Ah, I said it would bring out the power of the demon god... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power of the demon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demons trying to become gods... . I guess I'll have to go back and talk to Iris first... . Is it really over?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … I think it's all over. Are you okay, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico!! Rico, are you okay?
(Ricotta looks at %s's face as he grabs both hands with a surprised expression.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm fine, but %s... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because of the situation in front of me, I couldn't really care about Rico... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm sorry. I was not able to help Adventurer. I could only stare as I collapsed.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: When I came to my senses, the barrier that was blocking me disappeared... . ah… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Hey, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico? why?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: While %s was down, the Archduke took something from the Demon God.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?! Did you see what that was?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I couldn't see clearly because of the glare. Maybe that's why the power within it disappeared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean. Once you go out... . uh?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.
(Ricotta quietly looks towards where %s's gaze is directed. Only traces of the battle from before are visible, but nothing else is visible.)
(Meanwhile, a small brown bird that looks like it was seen from somewhere flies and lands on Ricotta's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Bird?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphide? No, bobby pins?!
(A small bird flaps its wings vigorously as if saying yes. Then, it comes in front of the two people and looks to one side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I go that way?
(The bobby pin chirps with a clear, sweet sound as if to say yes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, this bird is like a spirit. If you follow this bird, you can go outside.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.
(Ricotta looks to one side again, but sees nothing. So the two follow Bobbipin and set out to find a way out of the Pleroma.)
(After a while, Ricotta and %s looked at each other, but a human shape was created where there was nothing.)
(A red-haired man wearing glasses quietly bites his nails as if he is anxious. Then he looks at the road they left.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It wasn't time for Demiurge to wake up... . Also, why did Barbatos appear?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Damn… . Noname That guy ran away and everything went wrong. Ha, what should I do... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: … Aaron is going to kill me. It will take some more time to turn Narsha into a vessel... .

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: … Once you get out of here... . We have to unseal all the banned books in the Magic Agency. Quickly and perfectly make the bowl... … .

steps.name: La Vita
steps.objective:
1. After speaking with [Ricota] in “Slum Rashuet,” go to “Slum Rashuet Entrance.” 
2. Go to the place where [Narsha] is located at the “Slum Rashuet Entrance”, check what is happening, and then report the quest to [Narsha].

lines.text: (When Ricotta extends her hand, a bobby pin quietly flies out and lands.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thanks, bobbypin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good job, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm sorry I didn't do much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it helped me a lot. Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Are you okay?
(Ricotta supports Adventurer, who is trying to sit down due to weakness in his legs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I suddenly felt dizzy... . I think I need a little rest... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … If only I had been a little stronger... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the same for me too. If only I were a little stronger... . Ah, but what happens on the other side?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If I'm right, it will disappear soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because the demon spirit disappeared?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Most of the problems I have encountered so far disappear when the biggest factor causing them is removed. There may be places where this is not the case.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Since the gigantic being called the Demon God has disappeared, the external beings wandering around there will also disappear soon.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: And, %s. You need to rest right now. You look so tired right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . It’s okay… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Still, Silpin tells me to leave quickly.
(The bobby pin flies to %s's side and bites his collar. Then he pulls it as if he wants to go out the way he came.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, bobby pin. okay. I knew.
(In response to %s’s response, a bobby pin places the collar.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I will support you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don’t have to do this… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: No. Let’s go together to the entrance of Rashuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you… .
(Like that, Ricotta and %s, the two people take steps, following the bobby pin flying ahead.)
(As we move forward, leaving behind the back alley that was filled with an uneasy feeling, people who had not been seen appear one by one, along with Lashuette Street.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: We're all here. Where do we go now? But where are the bobby pins… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think he went back to doing his job. Once you go inside from here, you will find an inn… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Why is it so noisy here? %s, hey… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There's the Order of the Scars of the Red Moon over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .
(A middle-aged man approaches the two people who were looking inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Manuel?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: As expected... . His Majesty said that it was time for you to come... .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: You two, follow me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Your Majesty, what do you mean... .
(Narsha pricks her ears as she looks at Kaina's face holding her hand.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Literally.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His Majesty is reigning... That means...)
(Ricotta and %s decide to stand back and wait.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Narsha, as I said, don’t meet Raven from now on. This is Hwang Myeong.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Miss Narsha, the knights are chasing him.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes? no way… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I can't go into detail, but Raven will make Narsha unhappy. therefore… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I will do as you command, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: For the time being, the Knights will protect Miss Narsha. Please understand even if it is inconvenient.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you for your concern. By the way, %s, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, I'm fine. You'll be fine if you get some rest.
(Narsha looks at Argent and Kaina alternately, then quietly steps back.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Sir Manuel… .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now you don't have to come to Rashuet. The issue you are concerned about has been resolved.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Likewise, I can't tell you in detail, but the Gentleman disappears... . No, I self-destructed.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I will accept your orders. But even if it wasn’t because of that, Rashuet… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I am aware of the Laschouette maintenance project submitted by the National Assembly.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. It was something I had to do. Rashuet, where our ancestors settled and lived, was the root of Glaston, so it could not be left as is.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: My father also worked hard for the development of Rashuet, but because of the council... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Sir Manuel will persuade the other nobles in the council to ensure that everything goes smoothly.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Yes? your majesty? Are you saying that Chairman Aaron and other nobles agreed?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: … yes.
(Manuel touches his forehead in disbelief. But he nods quietly when he sees Kaina’s eyes looking at him.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now you can trust me and go back, Sir Manuel. Next time, I will meet you quietly.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.
(After the story is over, Manuel, who is stepping back, looks at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: … I'm not sure, but you did it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes… .
(Manuel nods slightly to %s and leaves La Chouette Street.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, Rico.
(Caina grabs Ricotta, who is about to kneel, and lifts her up.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Your Majesty… ,

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I heard the story from Dana. great job.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: No, %s is better than me… .
(Kaina approaches %s and grabs his hands.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, %s. The Empire, no, I, Kaina Dun Sylvaria, owe %s a debt that will never be repaid.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thanks to you, I no longer see Glaston’s uncertain future.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And I'm sorry... . I let you carry that burden alone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did it, but for some reason I don't feel like I finished it properly. There the Archduke... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, just thinking about now. The Archduke... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, did you see something more in the premonition?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That’s… .
(At that time, someone's clear and hopeful voice rang out from somewhere on the streets of Lashuette.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What is this singing voice?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Papnstar Daisy from Lashuette. They say they sing for the streets.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He seems to be a famous person.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Shall we listen for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? There are a lot of people here... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This is okay. There are no dangerous people... .
(Argent seems to be used to Kaina's unexpected behavior and seems to be nonchalant. Still, he has to do his duty as a knight, so he raises his hand lightly.)
(Then, knights who look like residents come out of nowhere and surround Kaina and the group.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: At this rate, His Majesty will never be seen outside.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Argent, there’s no need to tell me that you’re that short.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No, Your Majesty… . It's a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Hehe, it's just a joke. There was a Pope Star with a voice like that. It's really cool. Oh, Argent, there's Sylvia too.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Wow! Daisy Sister!! Take me!!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Ah… , Sylvia… … … .
(After Daisy's first song ends, the next song is played. People who knew what the song was from the beginning cheer with excited expressions.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: La Chouette La Vita… ♬

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Uh… .

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Rashuet La Vita… ♬ Even if you open your eyes or close them. The cheerful owl dreams♪ and sings♩

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Don't try to lock me in a cage♬
(Kaina focuses on Daisy singing as if she were possessed.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Because I have to continue living in the future... .
(%s Also, like Kaina, close your eyes and listen to Daisy's clear and clear song.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Kaina, you have to keep dreaming as you live. That's what I live for... . So you shouldn't give up... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Ah, %s. To me for a moment... . No, I'll go.
(Kaina approaches %s to see if she has something to say. And whispers quietly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? yes… , your majesty… . All right.
(Daisy safely sings the last song amidst the cheers of the people. After taking a sip of water and catching her breath, Daisy smiles brightly at the audience.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Thank you, everyone! Today’s performance is now over. Next time, please look forward to the next time. Three, four! It's been Daisy so far.
(With Daisy's greeting, the warm air that shook people's hearts fills the streets of La Chuette. It seemed like Glaston's work was over...)
(In the north, where Kaina's gaze rests, a different future that no one could have imagined was being created.)
